description: Lint a commit message against the Conventional Commits v1.0.0 spec: header format (type(scope)!: description), blank-line separation before the body/footers, footer token format, and BREAKING CHANGE casing. Returns the parsed type/scope/description/body/footers plus a list of error and warning findings.

maxHeaderLength.description: Header length that triggers a warning (default 100)

message.description: The full commit message: header, optional blank line, optional body, optional footers

types.description: Override the recognized type list (default: build, chore, ci, docs, feat, fix, perf, refactor, revert, style, test). Unrecognized types are a warning, not an error.

name: lint_conventional_commit
